item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi gtad bcol gnad gzer man ngag rno so ngar ma
item.coloph: de ltar mnan pa bzhi sbyor las 'di ni/ dus mtha'i 'kho (mthar mkho) phyir kho bo bdag gis sbyor(sbyar/)dam ldan skal pa ldan gyis nyams su long (longs/)log lta'i sde la ser gyis kha bzhin sdam/ rjes 'brang gshen po rnams kyis nyams la gzob(gzobs/)skabs shig bon chos bstan pa nyams phra'i dus/ zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug byangagi phyogs/ gnas mchog rin chen brag la gter du sbos/ phyis su 'arten (rten) phun tshogs lnga shar tshe/ dmu tsha'i rnam rol gshed bzhi lo pa yi/ zab mo gter gyis skal pa rnyed par shog sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya// phyis su bdag 'dra gshen spral thugs rje nyi mas phug leb 'o ma stag rtse nas/ zab mo gter gyi sgrom bu rnyed te (de/)gsang rgya sdom (bsdams/)slar hor sras mchog gis dgongs bzhed dang / grogs (khyung) za bskal (bza' skal) bzang lha mo dang / bstan sbyin bra bo rgyal mtshan sogs kyi ngo skar (skal) du/ gshen gyi pho brang du shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
